name: mvt
signature: void mvt(long n, double *x1, double *x2, const double *y_1, const double *y_2, const double *A)
layout: A is an n x n matrix stored row-major: element (i, j) is A[i*n + j]. x1, x2, y_1 and y_2 have n elements. x1 and x2 are input and output: the function adds to their initial values. No two arrays overlap. n is at least 1.
